recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中許多紅血球邊緣有半圓形缺口（咬痕細胞 bite cell），部分紅血球血紅素偏向一側、另一側淡染或呈水泡狀，還有少數不規則收縮的細胞，旁邊一顆正常嗜中性球作大小對照，是氧化性溶血的表現。
features: Numerous bite cells (keratocyte-like red cells with one or more semicircular peripheral defects)
Occasional blister cells / hemighost-like cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side
Scattered helmet-shaped and irregularly contracted dense red cells
Some larger, slightly grayer red cells suggesting polychromasia
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil; platelets present, no schistocyte-predominant picture
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous bite cells with semicircular peripheral defects, along with occasional blister cells in which hemoglobin is retracted to one side, helmet-shaped forms and irregularly contracted red cells. Scattered larger, slightly bluish red cells suggest polychromasia. A morphologically normal segmented neutrophil is present, and platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, such as G6PD deficiency or oxidant drug exposure; a supravital stain for Heinz bodies and G6PD assay (after the acute episode) are recommended.

ddx.vs: MAHA shows predominant fragmented schistocytes (triangles, helmets, microspherocytes) with thrombocytopenia, rather than bite and blister cells with hemoglobin retraction.

ddx.dx: Hereditary spherocytosis / warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: Spherocytic hemolysis shows round dense cells lacking central pallor without bite defects or eccentric hemoglobin, and AIHA is DAT-positive.
Unstable hemoglobins also cause Heinz bodies and bite cells, so hemoglobin electrophoresis/isopropanol stability testing with a normal G6PD level separates them.
Artifact produces crenated or refractile cells uniformly in one area of the smear, not true semicircular bites with eccentric hemoglobin distribution.
